description: Stack the caller-current persistent MathDx batch-640 n=512 winner with the grouped block-256 batch-8 n=2048 full stack. Preserve their shared f041 small/direct/CuTe base, import each device-resident path only at its target shape, unify extension state and prewarmed caches, validate all stream/policy guards, and tune setup interactions without changing other dispatch.

All policy, official, and fresh-seed checks passed; grouped cell was 3095.404 us versus 3095.934, while MathDx sampled 2068.968 versus 1937.076 and aggregate was 1009.348271 versus 1000.488361.

Added dedicated MathDx input/output/Numba-view caching and early dispatch, bypassing generic direct/mixed setup on batch-640 n512. All guards passed; MathDx measured 2007.168 us versus 2068.968 in the preceding run, grouped n2048 was 3097.065 us, and aggregate measured 1003.998564.

All validation passed; MathDx measured 1943.508 us versus 1937.076 in the exact merge, grouped n2048 measured 3096.172 versus 3095.934, and aggregate was 1001.000261 versus 1000.488361.

Kept MathDx byte-identical and moved only grouped n2048 into a dedicated prewarmed Python helper. All checks passed; grouped measured 3117.694 us versus 3095.934 in the exact merge, MathDx sampled 2011.773 versus 1937.076, and aggregate measured 1004.509585 versus 1000.488361.

Combined the caller-current MathDx batch-640 n512 path with grouped block-256 batch-8 n2048 and measured a best 1000.488361 us at commit 9d7af0d6d089c2276ab89ef22cf5d1eac7e8f94b. The exact merge measured target cells 1937.076/3095.934 us. Moving grouped caching fully into C++ measured 1009.348271 (2068.968/3095.404); adding dedicated MathDx caching there measured 1003.998564 (2007.168/3097.065); applying MathDx-only cache to the exact merge measured 1001.000261 (1943.508/3096.172); grouped-only helper measured 1004.509585 (2011.773/3117.694). Every trial passed build, banned-stream/kernelguard policy, all 17 official tests, fresh-seed guards, and the full 15-cell benchmark. Keep exploring fixed-capacity C++ cache lookup, prewarmed Numba view/launch state without Python dictionaries, and caller-stream grouped cleanup fusion; target variance remains large enough that repeat comparator runs can sharpen small setup deltas.
